description: Rotterdam-based independent sustainability consultancy and Certified B Corporation supporting mid-market companies with sustainability strategy, ESG reporting, ratings and certifications such as EcoVadis, and climate and energy advisory.

Zurich-headquartered climate solutions company and sustainability consultancy founded by ETH Zurich graduates, advising public, private and civil-sector organisations on decarbonisation strategy, carbon footprinting and climate risk across more than 20 countries.

London-headquartered global pure-play sustainability consultancy combining the scale of professional-services groups with boutique expertise, advising organisations on net zero, ESG, nature and sustainable finance across 22 countries.

Specialist consultancy, engineering and advisory firm with hubs in Dubai and London, providing sustainability, environmental, carbon management and net-zero advisory for the built environment across the Middle East, Europe and Asia.

London-based climate consultancy with over two decades of experience helping businesses and governments develop, deliver and report decarbonisation and climate action plans, with offices across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas.

Employee-owned Australian consultancy dedicated entirely to sustainability and ESG, founded in Perth and operating in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane and Hobart, delivering carbon accounting, net zero strategy and corporate ESG support.

Montreal-based independent advisory firm providing ESG and sustainability integration, sustainable finance and responsible-investing advice to both corporations and institutional investors through a financial and double-materiality lens.

Hamilton, Ontario boutique ESG and sustainability consultancy serving businesses across Canada, the US and Europe with EcoVadis certification support, CDP and SBTi reporting, climate disclosure and sustainability training.
US sustainability consultancy specialising in green buildings, LEED consulting, energy services and corporate ESG strategy, recognised as a LEED Proven Provider by the U.S. Green Building Council.

Kolkata-based independent advisory, research, audit and training organisation helping businesses across India with sustainability strategy, ESG reporting, environment and energy, safety and business-excellence at strategic and operational levels.

Pune-based ESG consulting and technology firm helping enterprises redefine sustainability strategy, minimise ESG and supply-chain risk and manage sustainability data through its resustain SaaS platform for reporting and disclosures.

Cincinnati-based corporate investigations and due-diligence firm with more than 30 years' experience, conducting international OSINT and HUMINT enhanced due diligence, complex corporate investigations and third-party risk management for Fortune 100 and 500 corporations.

New York-headquartered corporate investigations firm that gathers facts before hiring, before transactions, during disputes and after fraud, having conducted over 10,000 investigations in more than 100 countries across offices on five continents.

New York-based investigative, compliance and risk-advisory firm founded by Jules and Jeremy Kroll, with a global team of forensic accountants, former prosecutors, data scientists and e-discovery experts handling financial investigations, due diligence and disputes.

Specialist forensic accounting and investigations consultancy with major offices in London, Washington DC and Paris, providing integrated forensic accounting, data analytics, e-discovery and compliance support on complex multi-jurisdictional matters.

London-headquartered global business intelligence and investigations consultancy providing in-depth integrity due diligence, strategic intelligence, ESG intelligence and litigation support, with offices in New York, Washington DC, Zurich and Singapore.

London-based strategic advisory and corporate intelligence consultancy founded by former Kroll executives, specialising in enhanced due diligence, commercial intelligence, investigations, asset tracing and cyber advisory for multinationals and financial institutions.

Australian financial advisory firm founded in 1999 specialising in forensic accounting, litigation support, corporate recovery and insolvency, with offices across Australia, New Zealand and South East Asia.

Toronto-based boutique firm specialising in damages quantification, business valuation and forensic accounting, founded by former Navigant and Kroll Lindquist Avey principals and frequently retained as expert witnesses on complex Canadian disputes.

India-based integrity-management and risk-mitigation consultancy headquartered in Gurugram, offering corporate investigations, due diligence, background checks, asset tracing and digital forensics across emerging and frontier markets.

Hong Kong boutique corporate investigations firm conducting business intelligence, due diligence and fraud investigations across Hong Kong, Macau, China and, through partners, the wider Asia-Pacific region.

Boutique corporate intelligence and investigations advisory firm operating across Asia, conducting complex due-diligence and investigation projects in Hong Kong, mainland China, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Japan and South Korea.

Chicago-headquartered independent commercial real estate valuation and consulting firm with ten offices across the US and Latin America, providing conflict-free appraisals, advisory, litigation support and due diligence rather than brokerage.

Chicago-based privately held commercial real estate valuation and advisory firm offering appraisal and counseling services across North America for office, retail, industrial, multifamily, hospitality and special-use property types.

The largest independent commercial property valuation and advisory firm in the US, owned by its local practice leaders rather than a brokerage, providing appraisals and advisory across office, industrial, retail, multifamily and hospitality from dozens of offices.

Toronto-headquartered independent commercial real estate advisory and software firm providing valuation, appraisal management, cost consulting, due diligence and data analytics for CRE investors, fund managers, lenders and public entities worldwide.

Australia's largest independent property advisory firm, first established as a valuations practice in the early 1970s, delivering multidisciplinary advisory, research, valuation and project services from offices in Melbourne, Sydney, Brisbane, the Gold Coast, Canberra and Singapore.

Australian property valuation and advisory firm with more than 40 years' experience and over 120 specialists nationally, providing valuation, asset advisory, rating and taxation, research and litigation and acquisition services across commercial property sectors.

Independent Australian property and business valuation firm operating nationally from Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Adelaide and Perth, specialising in complex and specialised property valuations, financial-reporting valuations and litigation and family-law expert reports.

One of the UK's largest independent firms of chartered surveyors and property consultants and a Certified B Corporation, offering commercial property valuation, agency, asset management and advisory from offices across England.

One of the largest independent property consultancies in the Middle East and an RICS-regulated firm, providing valuation, advisory, agency, research and building consultancy across the UAE, Kuwait and Oman.

Chennai-based RICS-regulated property valuation and real estate consultancy founded in 2011, offering property valuations and end-to-end real estate advisory through RICS, IBBI and AIV-certified professionals across South India.

Long-established UK firm of chartered surveyors, agents, auctioneers and valuers operating from offices across the UK, delivering commercial property valuation, agency, building and project consultancy, rating and property management to owners, occupiers and financial institutions.
